subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula on the wall opposite the log near Jabu Jabu can be killed to collect its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: There is a Gold Skulltula on the wall opposite the log...kill it and collect...its token with the Boomerang.  Remember that it has to be at night.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: When you have 30 or more Skulltula tokens, the Giant Wallet upgrade becomes available from the House of Skulltula.

evidence.quote: When you have 30 or more Skulltula tokens...available from the House of Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Inside the Deku Tree past a web lit with a Deku Stick and a bombable fake wall, a Gold Skulltula is on the ceiling whose token can be retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Light the other web on fire with a Deku Stick, and bomb the fake wall past it...Inside, there is a Gold Skulltula on the ceiling.  Get the token with the Boomerang.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the window of Talon's house to the left of the entrance, and its token can be collected with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Look up on Talon's house left of the entrance, and there is a Gold Skulltula on the window...Get the token with the Boomerang.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: East of the door to the cow house in the southwest corner of the ranch, shoot the Gold Skulltula on the wall and grab its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: East of the door to the cow house, look on the wall...Shoot the Gold Skulltula and grab the token with the Boomerang.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula appears on the south wall of the graveyard.

evidence.quote: On the south wall of the graveyard, this Gold Skulltula appears.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Inside a bombable wall on the east wall while heading north on Death Mountain, a Gold Skulltula token can be collected.

evidence.quote: On the east wall as you go north, there is a bombable wall...Get the skulltula token inside the joint.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Climbing up the side of the staircase in Dodongo's Cavern allows you to reach a Gold Skulltula in a hole in the wall.

evidence.quote: Climb up the side of the staircase, and you can reach the Gold Skulltula in the hole in the wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is on the backside of the scientist's lab, and the Boomerang is required to collect its token.

evidence.quote: On the backside of the scientist's lab, there is a Gold Skulltula...The Boomerang is required to get the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Examine the mini-waterfall to the right of the tiny bridge upon entering Gerudo Valley to get the token from the Gold Skulltula there.

evidence.quote: Soon after you enter, examine the mini-waterfall to the right of the tiny bridge...Get the token from the Gold Skulltula there.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing the ground near the lone tree in the northeast corner of Hyrule Field reveals a hole containing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In the very northeast corner of Hyrule Field, there is a lone tree on the right side of the river...Bomb the ground near it and fall in the hole, then kill the Gold Skulltula inside.

subject: Zelda
text: Approaching the Market after beating the third dungeon triggers a cutscene in which Zelda tosses the Ocarina into the moat.

evidence.quote: When you approach the Market after beating the third dungeon, a cutscene occurs in which Zelda tosses the Ocarina into the moat.

subject: Zelda
text: Picking up the Ocarina of Time prompts Zelda to teach you the Song of Time.

evidence.quote: When you pick up the Ocarina, Zelda teaches you this song.

subject: Happy Mask Shop
text: Selling the Bunny Hood to the running man at night fills your wallet with rupees, after which the Happy Mask Shop manager gives you the Mask of Truth.

evidence.quote: When he sits down to rest, sell him the Bunny Hood and he will fill your entire wallet with rupees...Talk to the Happy Mask Shop manager and he will give you the Mask of Truth.

subject: Deku Scrubs
text: Wearing the Mask of Truth in the hole near the butterflies in the Lost Woods causes the Deku Scrubs to give you the 40 Capacity Deku Nut Holder upgrade.

evidence.quote: - Get 40 Capacity Deku Nut Holder (Lost Woods)...Wear the Mask of Truth and walk forward, and the Deku Scrubs will give you this Deku Nut upgrade.

subject: Temple of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time in front of the Altar in the Temple of Time begins the Adult Link phase of the quest.

evidence.quote: Enter the Temple of Time, from the Market...Play the Song of Time in front of the Altar to begin the second phase of Link's quest.

subject: Rauru
text: The Light Sage Rauru gives Link the Light Medallion upon awakening as Adult Link.

evidence.quote: The Light Sage, Rauru, gives you this medallion when you awake as Adult Link.

subject: Ingo
text: Beating Ingo twice in a race on Epona allows Link to keep her, escaping Lon Lon Ranch by jumping over a side wall.

evidence.quote: He will challenge you to a race- beat him twice on Epona, and he will let you keep her...To escape Lon Lon Ranch afterwards, jump over one of the side walls.

subject: Graveyard
text: Riding the Magic Bean platform grown at the soft soil spot in the Graveyard allows you to reach a Heart Piece on the ledge.

evidence.quote: If you planted a Magic Bean earlier here at the soft soil spot, there is now a bean platform...Ride the platform up and get the Heart Piece from the ledge.

subject: Dampe
text: Completing Dampe's race through the course before the final door closes rewards Link with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: He challenges you to a race- if you can make it through the whole course before the final door closes, Dampe will give you the Hookshot.

subject: Windmill
text: Exiting the Dampe race into the top floor of the Kakariko Village windmill allows Link to jump over to a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: You will emerge into the top floor of a windmill in Kakariko Village...Jump over to the Heart Piece here.

subject: Windmill Man
text: Pulling out the Ocarina in front of the man in the windmill teaches Link the Song of Storms.

evidence.quote: Pull out your Ocarina in front of the man in the windmill, and he will teach you this song.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is on the other side of the big white arch at Ganon's Castle, requiring the Hookshot to kill it and get the token.

evidence.quote: On the other side of the big white arch, there's a Gold Skulltula...Use the Hookshot to kill it and get the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Climbing the ladder near the gate up to the ledge in Zora's River reveals a Gold Skulltula on the nearby wall.

evidence.quote: Climb up the ladder on the right side near the gate up to the ledge, and the Gold Skulltula is on the wall nearby.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At the top of the frozen waterfall in Zora's Domain, a Gold Skulltula on the high wall can be killed with the Hookshot to collect its token.

evidence.quote: Go all the way up to the top of the frozen waterfall here...Kill the Gold Skulltula on the high wall and get the token with the Hookshot.

subject: Zora's Fountain
text: Hopping across the frozen platforms past where Jabu Jabu used to be in Zora's Fountain leads to a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: Go past where Jabu Jabu used to be, and hop across the frozen platforms to get this Heart Piece.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall behind some icicles in the spinning fan room of the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: In the spinning fan room, there is a Gold Skulltula on the wall behind some icycles.

subject: Ice Cavern
text: Melting the red ice covering the big chest with blue fire allows you to get the dungeon map in the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Jump over to the red ice covering the big chest, and pour the blue fire on it to melt the ice...Get the map from the chest.

subject: Ice Cavern
text: Burning red ice with blue fire reveals a chest containing the compass in the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: You can also burn two patches of red ice, one guarding a chest with the compass and the other guarding a Heart Piece.

subject: Ice Cavern
text: Burning a patch of red ice with blue fire in the Ice Cavern frees a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: You can also burn two patches of red ice, one guarding a chest with the compass and the other guarding a Heart Piece.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula on the wall behind the Heart Piece in the Ice Cavern can be killed with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Look on the wall behind the Heart Piece, and kill the Gold Skulltula with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found on a wall across from a pit in the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: On one of the walls in this room, across from a pit, is a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Ice Cavern
text: In the Ice Cavern, defeating the enemy in the room past the red ice allows Link to obtain the Iron Boots from a chest.

evidence.quote: Go past the red ice to the next room, kill the enemy and get the Iron Boots from the chest.

subject: Sheik
text: Sheik appears in the Ice Cavern and teaches Link the Serenade of Water, which warps to Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: After that, Sheik appears and teaches you this song, which warps you to Lake Hylia.

subject: King Zora
text: Unfreezing King Zora with blue fire rewards Link with the Zora Tunic.

evidence.quote: Unfreeze him with the blue fire and he will give you the Zora Tunic.

subject: Zora's Fountain
text: Sinking to the bottom of Zora's Fountain with the Iron Boots lets Link collect a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: Swim to the middle of Zora's Fountain, then sink down with the Iron Boots and get the Heart Piece on the bottom surface.

subject: Cucco Lady
text: Talking to the Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village rewards Link with the Pocket Egg.

evidence.quote: To begin, go to Kakariko Village and talk to the Cucco Lady...She will give you the Pocket Egg.

subject: Cucco Lady
text: After hatching the egg and using the cucco to wake Talon, talking to the Cucco Lady yields Cojiro.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song twice to pass a day and the egg will hatch...use the cucco in front of the sleeping  Talon...After he leaves, talk to the Cucco Lady again and she will give you the Cojiro.

subject: Lost Woods
text: Trading Cojiro to the man one screen west of the Lost Woods entrance yields the Odd Mushroom.

evidence.quote: From the entrance, go west once...Give the Cojiro to the man to get the Odd Mushroom in return.

subject: Kakariko Village
text: Giving the Odd Mushroom to the witch behind the Kakariko potion shop rewards Link with the Potion.

evidence.quote: Jump down and enter the witch's shop here...Give the Odd Mushroom to her to get the Potion in return.

subject: Lost Woods
text: Giving the Potion to the girl where the man was in the Lost Woods rewards Link with the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote: Return to where the man was in the Lost Woods...Give the Potion to the girl to get the Poacher's Saw in return.

subject: Gerudo Valley
text: Trading the Poacher's Saw to the man outside the tent across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley yields the Broken Goron Sword.

evidence.quote: talk to the man outside the nearby tent...Give him the Poacher's Saw to get the Broken Goron Sword in return.

subject: Biggoron
text: Giving the Broken Goron Sword to the huge Goron at the top of Death Mountain yields the Prescription Card.

evidence.quote: Talk to the huge Goron that appears, and give him the Broken Goron Sword to get the Prescription Card in return.

subject: King Zora
text: King Zora gives Link the Eyeball Frog in exchange for the Prescription Card.

evidence.quote: Get to Zora's Domain and talk to King Zora...He will give you the Eyeball Frog in exchange for the Prescription Card.

subject: Lakeside Laboratory
text: The scientist at the Lakeside Laboratory in Lake Hylia gives Link the Eyedrops if delivered in time.

evidence.quote: Stop at the Lakeside Laboratory in the lake and go inside...The scientist will give you the Eyedrops if you make it in time.

subject: Biggoron
text: Delivering the Eyedrops to the huge Goron at the top of Death Mountain rewards Link with the Claim Check.

evidence.quote: Give him the Eyedrops to get the Claim Check.

subject: Biggoron
text: Passing 3 days with the Sun's Song allows Link to obtain the Biggoron's Sword from the huge Goron.

evidence.quote: Use the Sun's Song until 3 days have passed, then get the Biggoron's Sword from the huge Goron.

subject: Death Mountain
text: Riding the Magic Bean platform at the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern allows Link to collect a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: If you planted a Magic Bean at the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern earlier, you can ride the bean platform up at that spot to get a Heart Piece.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula climbs on the giant hanging central pedestal in Goron City, collectable with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: In Goron City, look for this Gold Skulltula climbing on the giant hanging central pedestal, and collect the token with the Hookshot.

subject: Goron City
text: A big Goron behind a third floor bombable passage in Goron City sells the fragile Giant's Knife for 200 rupees.

evidence.quote: On one of the third floor bombable passages, go through it to find a big Goron...He should be selling this fragile sword for 200 rupees.

subject: Goron City
text: Stopping the rolling Goron with a bomb in Goron City rewards Link with the Goron Tunic, which protects against extreme heat.

evidence.quote: Go down a floor from the top to the rolling Goron, bomb him to make him stop, and talk to him...He will give you the Goron Tunic, which protects against extreme heat.

subject: Sheik
text: Meeting Sheik across the broken bridge in Death Mountain Crater teaches Link the Bolero of Fire.

evidence.quote: Hookshot across the broken bridge, and you'll meet Sheik again...She teaches you this song.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: Collecting 50 Skulltula tokens makes a Heart Piece available from the House of Skulltula.

evidence.quote: When you have 50 Skulltula tokens, this Heart Piece becomes available from the House of Skulltula.

subject: Scarecrow
text: Playing the same song to the dancing scarecrow in Lake Hylia as Adult Link unlocks the Scarecrow's Song.

evidence.quote: If you played a song in front of the dancing scarecrow in Lake Hylia as Young Link, go back there and play the same song in front of the scarecrow as Adult Link to learn this song.

subject: Lake Hylia
text: Riding the Magic Bean platform next to the scientist's lab in Lake Hylia leads to a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: If you planted a Magic Bean next to the scientist's lab here earlier, you can ride the bean platform up and get a Heart Piece.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Catching a fish over 10 pounds at the Fishing Pond as Adult Link rewards you with the Golden Scale.

evidence.quote: Use the same technique you used before as Young Link to catch a big fish over 10 pounds, and you will get the Golden Scale.

subject: Lakeside Laboratory
text: Diving to the bottom of the pool in the Lakeside Laboratory with the Golden Scale earns a Heart Piece from the scientist.

evidence.quote: Dive down to the very bottom of the pool with the Golden Scale and the scientist will give you a Heart Piece.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Sinking to the bottom of the pool in the Lakeside Laboratory with Iron Boots and rolling into a crate reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Sink to the bottom of the pool in the lab with the Iron Boots, then roll into the nearby crate to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song beneath the high hole in Dodongo's Cavern allows you to Hookshot up and kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In the room with the Dodongo Larvae, stand beneath the big hole in the wall above and play the Scarecrow's Song...Hookshot to the scarecrow and kill the Gold Skulltula.

subject: Hyrule Field
text: Bombing near the gold-leaved tree north of Lon Lon Ranch reveals a hole where sinking to the bottom yields a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: Go north of Lon Lon Ranch until you come to a gold-leaved tree...Bomb the ground near it and fall in the hole...Sink down to the bottom to get the Heart Piece.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley, a Gold Skulltula is located behind the carpenter's tent.

evidence.quote: Jump across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley, then look behind the carpenter's tent to find this Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: On a stone pillar past the bridge before Gerudo Fortress, a Gold Skulltula is reachable with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: On a stone pillar past the bridge, before the entrance to Gerudo Fortress, this Gold Skulltula is reachable with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the southeast corner of Kokiri Forest by the House of Twins, a Gold Skulltula in the tree can be killed with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Go to the House of Twins in the southeast corner of the forest and look up in the tree...Kill the Gold Skulltula and get the token with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Riding the Magic Bean platform where you enter the Forest Stage in the Lost Woods allows Link to kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: If you planted a Magic Bean in the Lost Woods screen where you enter the Forest Stage, you can ride that platform up here and kill a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Climbing the ladder at the end of the hedges in Sacred Forest Meadow reveals a Gold Skulltula climbing on the left-side wall.

evidence.quote: At the end of the hedges, turn around and climb up the ladder...There is a Gold Skulltula climbing on the left-side wall here, reachable from the top of the hedges.

subject: Sheik
text: Going to where you first met Saria in the Sacred Forest Meadow prompts Sheik to teach you the Minuet of the Forest.

evidence.quote: Go to where you first met Saria as Young Link, and the Sheik will teach you this song.
